source_brief: targeted review for symmetry-aware video trajectory evidence acquisition

items.title: Better Aggregation in Test-Time Augmentation
items.venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)
items.reason: Supports treating transformed-view predictions as structured evidence whose aggregation can help or harm, rather than blindly averaging them.

items.title: Conformal Risk Control
items.reason: Provides the risk-control framing needed to calibrate abstention or acquisition decisions rather than interpreting confidence scores as guarantees.

items.title: How to Fix a Broken Confidence Estimator: Evaluating Post-hoc Methods for Selective Classification with Deep Neural Networks
items.venue: Proceedings of the Fortieth Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence
items.reason: Motivates evaluating confidence estimators by selective risk and coverage, not accepting model-reported confidence at face value.

items.title: Look Again Before You Abstain: Budgeted Conformal Evidence Acquisition for Reliable Vision-Language Model
items.reason: Directly supports bounded, task-conditioned evidence acquisition before abstention and warns that calibration must include the complete acquisition policy.

items.title: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
items.venue: Proceedings of the 36th International Conference on Machine Learning
items.reason: Establishes the reject-option and risk-coverage viewpoint used to separate reliable answerable cases from principled abstention cases.
